issues.title: Test Account Buttons Visible in Production Login
issues.description: The login page displays 'Fill Test Account 1' and 'Fill Test Account 2' buttons that auto-fill test credentials. This exposes test accounts and destroys user trust.
issues.expected_behavior: No test UI elements should be visible in production
issues.actual_behavior: Test account buttons are rendered and functional
issues.impact: Severe trust damage - users will question site legitimacy
issues.recommended_fix: Remove test account functionality from production builds using environment variable check

issues.title: API Backend Health Endpoint Not Responding
issues.description: The API health check endpoint at api.flamoral.com/health returns empty response, indicating potential backend issues.
issues.expected_behavior: Health endpoint should return 200 OK with status JSON
issues.impact: Core functionality may be blocked for all users
issues.recommended_fix: Verify backend services are running and properly configured

issues.title: Large Unoptimized JavaScript Bundle
issues.description: Main JavaScript bundle is 735KB uncompressed (~185KB gzipped), causing slow load times on mobile networks.
issues.expected_behavior: Main bundle should be under 200KB uncompressed
issues.impact: 3-4 second load times on slow connections, mobile bounce rate increase
issues.recommended_fix: Implement code splitting, lazy loading routes, and tree shaking optimization

issues.title: No Visible Forgot Password Link
issues.description: The login page does not have a prominently visible 'Forgot Password' link, blocking users from account recovery.
issues.expected_behavior: Clear 'Forgot Password?' link below password field
issues.actual_behavior: Link may exist but is not prominent
issues.impact: Users locked out of accounts cannot recover access
issues.recommended_fix: Add prominent 'Forgot your password?' link below password input

issues.title: SPA Without Server-Side Rendering
issues.description: Application is a pure SPA with empty root div, causing SEO issues and slow initial paint.
issues.expected_behavior: Critical content should be server-rendered or pre-rendered
issues.impact: Poor SEO ranking, slow first contentful paint
issues.recommended_fix: Implement SSR with framework like Next.js or pre-rendering for static pages

issues.title: No Social Login Option on Signup Page
issues.description: Social login (Google, Facebook) is only available on login page, not on signup page, increasing registration friction.
issues.expected_behavior: Google and Facebook signup buttons should be present
issues.recommended_fix: Add social signup buttons to registration page

issues.title: Missing Loading Indicators on Navigation
issues.description: Route transitions do not show loading indicators, leaving users unsure if their click registered.
steps_to_reproduce: No visual feedback during route change
issues.expected_behavior: Loading spinner or progress bar during navigation
issues.recommended_fix: Add route transition loading indicator (suspense fallback or NProgress)

issues.title: Multi-Step Signup Increases Friction
issues.description: Registration requires 2 separate steps without progress indicator, increasing abandonment.
issues.expected_behavior: Single page or clear progress stepper (Step 1 of 2)
issues.recommended_fix: Add visual progress stepper or consolidate to single page

issues.title: Limited Gender Selection Options
issues.description: Gender selection during signup may not include all gender identities, potentially excluding users.
issues.expected_behavior: Inclusive options: Man, Woman, Non-binary, Prefer not to say, Custom
issues.actual_behavior: Options may be limited to binary choices
issues.impact: Exclusion of non-binary and gender-diverse users
issues.recommended_fix: Add inclusive gender options with custom text field

issues.title: No User Testimonials or Social Proof
issues.description: Landing page lacks user testimonials, reviews, user counts, or success stories.
issues.expected_behavior: User testimonials, success stories, user count statistics
issues.recommended_fix: Add testimonials section with user photos and quotes

issues.title: No Third-Party Trust Badges
issues.description: No visible trust badges from security providers, app stores, or review platforms.
issues.expected_behavior: App store badges, security certifications, review scores
issues.recommended_fix: Add relevant trust badges (Norton Secured, BBB, app store ratings)

issues.title: No Offline Handling
issues.description: Application has no visible offline handling or service worker, fails silently when offline.
issues.expected_behavior: Offline indicator and cached content when available
issues.recommended_fix: Implement service worker with offline fallback page

issues.title: No Breadcrumb Navigation
issues.description: Deep pages lack breadcrumb navigation, making it harder to understand location in site.

issues.title: No Search Functionality
issues.description: No visible search feature for finding help content or FAQs.
issues.impact: Harder to find specific help topics
issues.recommended_fix: Add search functionality to help center

issues.title: No Language Selector
issues.description: No visible language or locale selector for international users.
steps_to_reproduce: Look for language selector in header/footer
issues.expected_behavior: Language dropdown in header or footer
